sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Best guide and build for Soldier 11 from ZZZ (Zenless Zone Zero). Soldier 11 is an rank character with the Fire attribute who belongs to the Attack Specialty and who is part of the OBOLS Squad faction.
 A model soldier who follows orders and stays loyal to the mission... At least that's what Soldier 11 demands of herself. Weapons don't need emotions, and need only follow orders... At least that's what Soldier 11 tells herself. No matter how strong the enemy, just get fired up and face it head on... At least that's what Soldier 11 does. She's shed her weakness along with her name, leaving only resolve... At least that's what Soldier 11 thinks.

 To learn more about Soldier 11 check the sections below. Use the tabs to quickly switch to the kind of information you're looking for.

sections.heading: Pros
sections.text:
Strong damage dealer with perfectly timed attacks that are on par with some Limited S-Rank Agents.

 Low resource management needs allows for both constant on-field presence and frequent, bursty stun rotations.

 Standard Banner unit that’s effectively free.

 Could eat something well over 2,000,000 on the scoville scale and be fine.

sections.heading: Cons
sections.text:
Relies on perfectly timed attacks to do well, demanding a high skill floor.

 Highly dependent on specific units (Dialyn, Lighter, etc.) and Limited S-Rank W-Engines to be truly competitive.

 Can sometimes struggle with Drive Disc set maintenance.

 Will find more ways than you thought possible to botch your name.

sections.heading: Intro & Unique Mechanic
sections.text:
Soldier 11 is a Fire Attack Agent who rewards players that can perfectly time her attacks, making use of her “Fire Suppression” mechanic to upgrade skills.
 Whenever Soldier 11 uses a Basic or Dash Attack, she will do Physical DMG. If, however, these attacks are perfectly timed then they will be enhanced to become a “Fire Suppression” variant, hitting much harder and dealing Fire DMG instead.
 “Fire Suppression” is more than just the name of her upgraded attacks though, as upon using certain skills, like her EX Special, Chain Attack and Ultimate, she will build Fire Suppression stacks . These are then used to forcibly upgrade attacks to their Fire Suppression variants without needing perfect timing.
 With her Potential Awakening however, the presence of these stacks can unlock a powerful 5th hit of her Basic Attack string, which itself can be further enhanced by consuming all remaining Fire Suppression stacks if done after a Chain Attack or Ultimate.
 This amounts to a gameplay approach where one has to pay close attention to their attack timings in the out-of-stun period, then use multiple heavy hitting skills in stun to burst enemies down.

sections.heading: Core Passive & Additional Ability
sections.text:
Fire Suppression enhanced attacks are stronger in both DMG multipliers and due to Soldier 11’s Core Passive, which grants a 70% DMG Bonus to them.
 Her Additional Ability needs either the same Attribute or Faction (Obol Squad) and provides:
 10% Fire DMG Bonus to all attacks.

 An additional 22.5% Fire DMG Bonus to all attacks against Stunned enemies.

 Up to 48% CRIT DMG at Potential Awakening 6.

 As a result of the significant stat boosts given by her Additional Ability, it’s very important that it is met in some way or another.

sections.heading: Kit Breakdown
sections.text:
The core of Soldier 11’s kit revolves around her Basic Attacks. She has 4 variants:
 Warmup Sparks, a weak, 4-part Physical DMG string.

 Fire Suppression, the enhanced Basic Attack string that is accessed either via perfect timing or by using up Fire Suppression stacks.

 Burst of Firepower, a manual counter stance accessed by holding the Basic Attack button, where releasing the button leads to the parry strike which then shortcuts to Fire Suppression’s B3.

 Fire Charge, an auto-counter that is built after using EX Specials, Chain Attacks or Ultimates and leads into Burst of Firepower’s parry strike, after which Soldier 11 will continue attacking from the latest attack string before its trigger.

 Although Fire Suppression Basics work with either perfect timing or using up Fire Suppression stacks, it is only while there are stacks available that the 5th hit of the string is unlocked. This Fire Suppression B5 will consume a stack, but if perfectly timed, can shortcut back to the 3rd hit of the string instead of starting again at 1.
 Each of these stacks lasts 15 seconds and cap out at 8, and to get them, Soldier 11 must either parry enemies with Burst of Firepower - giving 3 Fire Suppression stacks - or use EX Specials, Chain Attacks or Ultimates, all of which generate 8 Fire Suppression stacks and shortcut to her Fire Suppression B4.
 After using Chain Attacks or Ultimates however, have the added bonus of making the next Fire Suppression B5 be empowered. Instead of consuming 1 Fire Suppression stack like it usually does, it will use up all current Fire Suppression stacks and deal additional Fire DMG for every stack consumed.
 Each stack consumed increases the move’s DMG Multiplier by 166.4%, with a maximum of 6 stacks used at once. This is because Fire Suppression’s B4 and B5 each consume 1 stack, with the empower effect applying after. Even still, that’s over 1880% in DMG Multiplier with a single Basic Attack!
 Aside from her strong Basic Attacks and the skills that enable them, Soldier 11’s Dash Attack has a Fire Suppression enhancement, but unlike her Basic Attack, has no follow-up string or empowered variant beyond it, being little more than a segue into Basic Attack strings.
 As for her Dodge Counter it is surprisingly good, having solid multipliers all around and not interrupting her Basic Attack sequence if followed from within 5s. This means that if Soldier 11 gets a Perfect Dodge into Dodge Counter during her B3, she will go into her B4 after without resetting the sequence.
 Assists are mediocre, but Defensive Assists and Assist Follow-ups can be useful for building Decibels. Given the value Soldier 11’s Ultimate has, it’s sometimes worth using.
 Her Ultimate is plainly a very hard hitting skill, being among some of the strongest Attacker Ultimates at level 12, with a 4206% DMG Multiplier. The Chain Attack isn’t quite as strong, with it dealing only 1265% in DMG Multiplier, but both still benefit from 8 Fire Suppression stacks and the empowered B5 unlock.
 Soldier 11’s EX Special hits hard but can be quite expensive, with an 80 Energy cost, but her tendency to on-field and high Energy generation on her Basic Attacks means it isn’t too difficult to sustain.
 Overall, balancing out her resource generation and field time with those of her teammates and getting as many Fire Suppression B5s and empowered B5s out as possible is the gameplan, being straightforward in concept but at times demanding in execution.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.text:
When in the out-of-stun state, Soldier 11’s relies on your ability to perfectly time attacks to get Fire Suppression Basic Attack strings out, with Burst of Firepower being used to counter enemy attacks for the free 3 Fire Suppression stacks and shortcut to B3, ensuring that B5 can be used.
 As Energy builds, use EX Specials for the 8 Fire Suppression stacks that it gives and instead of using Burst of Firepower, make use of the B5 → B3 shortcut and Perfect Dodges into Dodge Counters to preserve Basic Attack sequences until stacks have been used (which should amount to 3 B5s in total).
 Don’t get bogged down in only doing Soldier 11 Basic Attacks though, as it’s still important to maintain buff uptime with supportive units and build Daze with Stunners. As Soldier 11 doesn’t have many resources to manage, the more stuns she gets in a fight the better.
 Once Stun arrives, she has the following combo shell:
 Chain Attack (or Ultimate, with Dialyn’s conversion)

 B4

 EB5

 Swap to another character to trigger Chain

 Soldier 11 Chain Attack

 B4

 EB5

 Ultimate

 B4

 EB5

 EX Special

 B4

 B5

 B3, and so on, until Stun expires.

 After which it’s back to timing Fire Suppressions out-of-stun, parrying with Burst of Firepower and getting the occasional EX Special for B5, B3, B4, B5 looping.
 Do take care to build enough Decibels on Soldier 11 for frequent Ultimates, feeding her Defensive Assists and Assist Follow-Ups where required, but otherwise what needs to be done is simple. Just gotta practice those perfect timings!

 Build and teams

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Soldier 11 . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Lighter Koleda - The 2 Fire Stun options are the most obvious-looking choice for Soldier 11, and indeed Lighter is the best Stun Agent she has. Lighter is able to massively buff Fire DMG and reduce the Fire RES of enemies which boosts Soldier 11's damage by a ton, all the while dealing massive Daze. Koleda shares the Daze infliction but her buffs are limited to Chain Attacks and aren't as desirable, but she remains a good choice.
 Trigger Ju Fufu Pulchra - These off-field Stun choices are less natural than Lighter but work brilliantly with Soldier 11. Pulchra at M6 gives a nice DMG% buff for Soldier 11 to exploit and Trigger gives a huge Stun DMG Multiplier increase as well, while Ju Fufu focuses more on improving CRIT DMG, Ultimate DMG and Chain Attack DMG. All characters deal damage and Daze while off-field which allows Soldier 11 to take that field time instead and deal a lot of damage while the others back up her Daze infliction off-field, making the pairings surprisingly strong. strong.
 Orphie & Magus Seed - These two Attack Agents can and want to be paired alongside other Attack Agents who function as main damage dealers in order for their kits to work well. This is because Seed and Orphie are able to buff Attack Agents in several ways. Seed gives them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. Orphie on the other hand provides ATK buffs and deals Aftershock damage on top of contributing some Fire Anomaly while operating completely off-field if desired! For these reasons, they work well as a mix of DPS and Support for Soldier 11. Great pairings overall.
 Yuzuha Astra Yao Lucy - These 3 generalist units are capable of acting as Support for any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. However, Soldier 11 is an exception due to her tendency to run and need to upkeep Inferno Metal's set bonus. For this reason, Yuzuha can be a great choice as well as not only does she apply lots of Anomaly, she also has awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her general use potential. Lastly, Lucy has long-lasting ATK and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her a very practical choice, especially in Fire teams where she can help with building Anomaly and trigger Additional Abilities. All in all, these three can work with anyone.
 Dialyn - Depending on how Soldier 11 is built, Dialyn may end up as the best Stunner option. She offers a wide array of buffs, has some of the highest Daze application in the game, extends stun durations and - most importantly - gives Soldier 11 the ability to get an extra Ultimate every stun. With how steep her Ultimate multipliers are, when coupled with Evelyn's Signature W-Engine and Astra's extra Chains, the raw amount of in-stun burst Soldier 11 can dish out more than makes up for the lack of an Additional Ability. Even without Evelyn's W-Engine, Dialyn is still a remarkably competitive option, and can even be run alongside other Supports or even Lighter for decent results.

Below we list only the most important synergies for Soldier 11 . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Lighter Koleda - The 2 Fire Stun options are the most obvious-looking choice for Soldier 11, and indeed Lighter is the best Stun Agent she has. Lighter is able to massively buff Fire DMG and reduce the Fire RES of enemies which boosts Soldier 11's damage by a ton, all the while dealing massive Daze. Koleda shares the Daze infliction but her buffs are limited to Chain Attacks and aren't as desirable, but she remains a good choice.
 Trigger Ju Fufu Pulchra - These off-field Stun choices are less natural than Lighter but work brilliantly with Soldier 11. Pulchra at M6 gives a nice DMG% buff for Soldier 11 to exploit and Trigger gives a huge Stun DMG Multiplier increase as well, while Ju Fufu focuses more on improving CRIT DMG, Ultimate DMG and Chain Attack DMG. All characters deal damage and Daze while off-field which allows Soldier 11 to take that field time instead and deal a lot of damage while the others back up her Daze infliction off-field, making the pairings surprisingly strong. strong.
 Orphie & Magus Seed - These two Attack Agents can and want to be paired alongside other Attack Agents who function as main damage dealers in order for their kits to work well. This is because Seed and Orphie are able to buff Attack Agents in several ways. Seed gives them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. Orphie on the other hand provides ATK buffs and deals Aftershock damage on top of contributing some Fire Anomaly while operating completely off-field if desired! For these reasons, they work well as a mix of DPS and Support for Soldier 11. Great pairings overall.
 Yuzuha Astra Yao Lucy - These 3 generalist units are capable of acting as Support for any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. However, Soldier 11 is an exception due to her tendency to run and need to upkeep Inferno Metal's set bonus. For this reason, Yuzuha can be a great choice as well as not only does she apply lots of Anomaly, she also has awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her general use potential. Lastly, Lucy has long-lasting ATK and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her a very practical choice, especially in Fire teams where she can help with building Anomaly and trigger Additional Abilities. All in all, these three can work with anyone.
 Dialyn - Depending on how Soldier 11 is built, Dialyn may end up as the best Stunner option. She offers a wide array of buffs, has some of the highest Daze application in the game, extends stun durations and - most importantly - gives Soldier 11 the ability to get an extra Ultimate every stun. With how steep her Ultimate multipliers are, when coupled with Evelyn's Signature W-Engine and Astra's extra Chains, the raw amount of in-stun burst Soldier 11 can dish out more than makes up for the lack of an Additional Ability. Even without Evelyn's W-Engine, Dialyn is still a remarkably competitive option, and can even be run alongside other Supports or even Lighter for decent results.

 Review

 Ratings
 This tier list assesses Agents (characters) based on their combat potential in Zenless Zone Zero's most demanding contents - Deadly Assault (DA) and Shiyu Defense (SD) . Please keep in mind Zenless Zone Zero is a skill-based game and each character has a different playstyle, difficulty level and even special tricks and combos. Zenless Zone Zero is also a team based game and it's only by combining both these factors to the highest level a character can reach optimal performance.

 Crit DPS
 T1.5
 Endgame Modes

 Pros & Cons
 Pros
 Strong damage dealer with perfectly timed attacks that are on par with some Limited S-Rank Agents.

 Low resource management needs allows for both constant on-field presence and frequent, bursty stun rotations.

 Standard Banner unit that’s effectively free.

 Could eat something well over 2,000,000 on the scoville scale and be fine.

 Cons
 Relies on perfectly timed attacks to do well, demanding a high skill floor.

 Highly dependent on specific units (Dialyn, Lighter, etc.) and Limited S-Rank W-Engines to be truly competitive.

 Can sometimes struggle with Drive Disc set maintenance.

 Will find more ways than you thought possible to botch your name.

 Review
 Intro & Unique Mechanic
 Soldier 11 is a Fire Attack Agent who rewards players that can perfectly time her attacks, making use of her “Fire Suppression” mechanic to upgrade skills.
 Whenever Soldier 11 uses a Basic or Dash Attack, she will do Physical DMG. If, however, these attacks are perfectly timed then they will be enhanced to become a “Fire Suppression” variant, hitting much harder and dealing Fire DMG instead.
 “Fire Suppression” is more than just the name of her upgraded attacks though, as upon using certain skills, like her EX Special, Chain Attack and Ultimate, she will build Fire Suppression stacks . These are then used to forcibly upgrade attacks to their Fire Suppression variants without needing perfect timing.
 With her Potential Awakening however, the presence of these stacks can unlock a powerful 5th hit of her Basic Attack string, which itself can be further enhanced by consuming all remaining Fire Suppression stacks if done after a Chain Attack or Ultimate.
 This amounts to a gameplay approach where one has to pay close attention to their attack timings in the out-of-stun period, then use multiple heavy hitting skills in stun to burst enemies down.
 Core Passive & Additional Ability
 Fire Suppression enhanced attacks are stronger in both DMG multipliers and due to Soldier 11’s Core Passive, which grants a 70% DMG Bonus to them.
 Her Additional Ability needs either the same Attribute or Faction (Obol Squad) and provides:
 10% Fire DMG Bonus to all attacks.

 An additional 22.5% Fire DMG Bonus to all attacks against Stunned enemies.

 Up to 48% CRIT DMG at Potential Awakening 6.

 As a result of the significant stat boosts given by her Additional Ability, it’s very important that it is met in some way or another.
 Kit Breakdown
 The core of Soldier 11’s kit revolves around her Basic Attacks. She has 4 variants:
 Warmup Sparks, a weak, 4-part Physical DMG string.

 Fire Suppression, the enhanced Basic Attack string that is accessed either via perfect timing or by using up Fire Suppression stacks.

 Burst of Firepower, a manual counter stance accessed by holding the Basic Attack button, where releasing the button leads to the parry strike which then shortcuts to Fire Suppression’s B3.

 Fire Charge, an auto-counter that is built after using EX Specials, Chain Attacks or Ultimates and leads into Burst of Firepower’s parry strike, after which Soldier 11 will continue attacking from the latest attack string before its trigger.

 Although Fire Suppression Basics work with either perfect timing or using up Fire Suppression stacks, it is only while there are stacks available that the 5th hit of the string is unlocked. This Fire Suppression B5 will consume a stack, but if perfectly timed, can shortcut back to the 3rd hit of the string instead of starting again at 1.
 Each of these stacks lasts 15 seconds and cap out at 8, and to get them, Soldier 11 must either parry enemies with Burst of Firepower - giving 3 Fire Suppression stacks - or use EX Specials, Chain Attacks or Ultimates, all of which generate 8 Fire Suppression stacks and shortcut to her Fire Suppression B4.
 After using Chain Attacks or Ultimates however, have the added bonus of making the next Fire Suppression B5 be empowered. Instead of consuming 1 Fire Suppression stack like it usually does, it will use up all current Fire Suppression stacks and deal additional Fire DMG for every stack consumed.
 Each stack consumed increases the move’s DMG Multiplier by 166.4%, with a maximum of 6 stacks used at once. This is because Fire Suppression’s B4 and B5 each consume 1 stack, with the empower effect applying after. Even still, that’s over 1880% in DMG Multiplier with a single Basic Attack!
 Aside from her strong Basic Attacks and the skills that enable them, Soldier 11’s Dash Attack has a Fire Suppression enhancement, but unlike her Basic Attack, has no follow-up string or empowered variant beyond it, being little more than a segue into Basic Attack strings.
 As for her Dodge Counter it is surprisingly good, having solid multipliers all around and not interrupting her Basic Attack sequence if followed from within 5s. This means that if Soldier 11 gets a Perfect Dodge into Dodge Counter during her B3, she will go into her B4 after without resetting the sequence.
 Assists are mediocre, but Defensive Assists and Assist Follow-ups can be useful for building Decibels. Given the value Soldier 11’s Ultimate has, it’s sometimes worth using.
 Her Ultimate is plainly a very hard hitting skill, being among some of the strongest Attacker Ultimates at level 12, with a 4206% DMG Multiplier. The Chain Attack isn’t quite as strong, with it dealing only 1265% in DMG Multiplier, but both still benefit from 8 Fire Suppression stacks and the empowered B5 unlock.
 Soldier 11’s EX Special hits hard but can be quite expensive, with an 80 Energy cost, but her tendency to on-field and high Energy generation on her Basic Attacks means it isn’t too difficult to sustain.
 Overall, balancing out her resource generation and field time with those of her teammates and getting as many Fire Suppression B5s and empowered B5s out as possible is the gameplan, being straightforward in concept but at times demanding in execution.

 How to play
 When in the out-of-stun state, Soldier 11’s relies on your ability to perfectly time attacks to get Fire Suppression Basic Attack strings out, with Burst of Firepower being used to counter enemy attacks for the free 3 Fire Suppression stacks and shortcut to B3, ensuring that B5 can be used.
 As Energy builds, use EX Specials for the 8 Fire Suppression stacks that it gives and instead of using Burst of Firepower, make use of the B5 → B3 shortcut and Perfect Dodges into Dodge Counters to preserve Basic Attack sequences until stacks have been used (which should amount to 3 B5s in total).
 Don’t get bogged down in only doing Soldier 11 Basic Attacks though, as it’s still important to maintain buff uptime with supportive units and build Daze with Stunners. As Soldier 11 doesn’t have many resources to manage, the more stuns she gets in a fight the better.
 Once Stun arrives, she has the following combo shell:
 Chain Attack (or Ultimate, with Dialyn’s conversion)

 B4

 EB5

 Swap to another character to trigger Chain

 Soldier 11 Chain Attack

 B4

 EB5

 Ultimate

 B4

 EB5

 EX Special

 B4

 B5

 B3, and so on, until Stun expires.

 After which it’s back to timing Fire Suppressions out-of-stun, parrying with Burst of Firepower and getting the occasional EX Special for B5, B3, B4, B5 looping.
 Do take care to build enough Decibels on Soldier 11 for frequent Ultimates, feeding her Defensive Assists and Assist Follow-Ups where required, but otherwise what needs to be done is simple. Just gotta practice those perfect timings!

This is because Seed and Orphie are able to buff Attack Agents in several ways. Seed gives them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. Orphie on the other hand provides ATK buffs and deals Aftershock damage on top of contributing some Fire Anomaly while operating completely off-field if desired! For these reasons, they work well as a mix of DPS and Support for Soldier 11. Great pairings overall.
 Yuzuha Astra Yao Lucy - These 3 generalist units are capable of acting as Support for any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. However, Soldier 11 is an exception due to her tendency to run and need to upkeep Inferno Metal's set bonus. For this reason, Yuzuha can be a great choice as well as not only does she apply lots of Anomaly, she also has awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her general use potential. Lastly, Lucy has long-lasting ATK and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her a very practical choice, especially in Fire teams where she can help with building Anomaly and trigger Additional Abilities. All in all, these three can work with anyone.
 Dialyn - Depending on how Soldier 11 is built, Dialyn may end up as the best Stunner option. She offers a wide array of buffs, has some of the highest Daze application in the game, extends stun durations and - most importantly - gives Soldier 11 the ability to get an extra Ultimate every stun. With how steep her Ultimate multipliers are, when coupled with Evelyn's Signature W-Engine and Astra's extra Chains, the raw amount of in-stun burst Soldier 11 can dish out more than makes up for the lack of an Additional Ability. Even without Evelyn's W-Engine, Dialyn is still a remarkably competitive option, and can even be run alongside other Supports or even Lighter for decent results.
